# `auth.totp.enroll`

Stage a TOTP secret

Session with fresh auth. Returns the otpauth URI and manual key once; verifying a code enables it.

- Method and path: `POST /settings/security/totp`
- Scope: `repo:read`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie auth totp enroll`
- MCP: `auth_totp_enroll`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |

## Errors

`unauthorized`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
